title.zh: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450 million as Clarity Act fails
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs shed $450 million as Clarity Act fails

current_state.zh: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $450 million in outflows, the largest since June, after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, driving regulatory-sensitive tokens sharply lower.
current_state.en: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $450 million in outflows, the largest since June, after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act, driving regulatory-sensitive tokens sharply lower.
